<!-- Purpose: Help contributors and maintainers review behavior and verification. -->
## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

State which automated or manual checks actually ran and their results.
Identify relevant checks that remain unverified.

## Data and release impact

Describe any storage migration, image cleanup, permission, or packaging change.
For documentation-only changes, state that here.

Link the issue addressed by this change. Keep contributions compatible with the
MIT license and preserve third-party notices. Do not include private clipboard data.
